Discover the best things to do in Da Nang at night with our complete Da Nang Nightlife Guide (2025). From vibrant bars and rooftop lounges to night markets, river cruises, and the famous Dragon Bridge fire show, this video covers the top nightlife spots in Da Nang, Vietnam.

Whether you’re looking for the best bars in Da Nang, lively clubs, relaxing evening activities, or cultural experiences, this guide will help you plan your nights in one of Vietnam’s most exciting coastal cities.
